title: Reflection Probe Cull Mask doesn't work well - Direct Lights disappeared
body: ### Tested versions Tested in 4.4.1 ### System information Win10, Fwd+ Vulkan, Ryzen 4650g vega igpu ### Issue description There was a PR in 4.3: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/86073 This is a long awaited feature to me, and it's a cool feature to get car reflections, but there is a glitch. When prevent a mesh to rendered by the reflection probe, like a cars body inside (or in my test case "mirror" mesh, because the backface of this mesh), the lights doesn't show on the rendered meshes by probe, on this "mirror" surface. The "mirror" mesh is a box. I can do this reflection with a plane, where the backface of plane culled, and that's work perfectly, but i wanted to test, when the "mirror" is a box, and i need to get rid off this mesh from the cubemap of reflection probe, because the visible back side, like a car body from inside. The size of "mirror" box is (10,1,10), and the offset of reflection probe is -2 on Y axis. I stand with the camera on +2 on Y axis to get perfect reflection, and this is the reason why i culled the mirror box, because i don't want to see the bottom side of this box in the reflection. The lights (white directional light, and purple omni) doesn't appear in the reflection. ### Steps to reproduce There is everything on the screenshot. I have: - a box mesh (size 10,1,10) as a mirror (metallic: 1.0, roughness: 0.0) - a small cubemesh to reflect that, at visual layer 2 - reflection probe with that settings on the screenshot, at 0,0,0 position - standard environment with a hdri sky - standard directional light and a purple omni - the mirror box at 0,-0.5,0 position, because the surface of this box can be at Y: 0, where is the center of probe at Y, to get perfect reflection on the X/Z plane ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) -
